top_signals.title: Goldman Sachs on India, Korea Opportunities
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Chief Regional Equity Strategist for Asia Pacific Timothy Moe says uncertainty and de-risking are weighing on the broader AI trade. Speaking with Bloomberg's Haslinda Amin and Avril Hong, he also outlines the case for India, and explains why they prefer Korea over Taiwan. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stocks Suffer Worst Run Since 2023, Havens Gain: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Global stocks posted their longest losing streak in more than three years as the artificial intelligence trade cratered after a bull run in 2026, sending investors to haven assets such as Treasuries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Shoprite Moves to End Tycoon Wiese’s Dual-Class Shares
top_signals.summary: Shoprite Holdings Ltd. moved to dismantle a 25-year-old structure that gives billionaire Christo Wiese voting rights that are disproportionately larger than his actual economic interest in Africa’s biggest supermarket retailer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
